description: Quantifier audit of commit 3ba40fc's identical-terminal four-path spectrum. It corrects existential-safe overlap constructions that were incorrectly promoted to universal safety and withdraws the resulting single A-C coincidence reduction.
scope_note: Hand-written exact path-incidence audit, not a proof-assistant verification or an ambient graph census. Abstract ladder incidences prove only colored path-system realizability; minimum degree, bridge closure, global F-cleanliness, attachments, and Q are deliberately not inferred.

level_1_pairwise_results.(R_x,S_x): FIXED_BY_SAME_THETA_GEOMETRY and FORCED_SAFE: one divergent cell P_1^x union P_2^x has odd length 2^rho_x+2^s_x-1.
level_1_pairwise_results.(R_x,R_y): SAFE_INCIDENCE_EXISTS_BUT_OTHERS_MAY_FAIL: disjoint equal exponents fail, unequal exponents are safe, equal exponents have a safe two-cell escape, and every exponent pair admits an abstract two-cell incidence exposing C4.
level_1_pairwise_results.(R_x,S_y): SAFE_INCIDENCE_EXISTS_BUT_OTHERS_MAY_FAIL: disjoint is safe and the old two-cell family is safe, but these are existential; a valid two-cell composition can expose C4.
level_1_pairwise_results.(S_x,S_y): SAFE_INCIDENCE_EXISTS_BUT_OTHERS_MAY_FAIL: disjoint is safe by valuation but cannot replace the actual paths; a valid two-cell composition can expose C4.

symbolic_countertest.statement: For totals m,n>=2 and m+n>=7, a positive two-cell composition with two valid simple-graph cells exists with a_1+b_1=4; every application here has total at least eight.
symbolic_countertest.application: Every cross-theta pair here has both totals at least four, so every cross-pair type admits an abstract incidence with a forbidden C4.

withdrawn_claims: The two mixed cross-theta pairs are always safe under arbitrary overlap.
The existence of a safe disjoint S_x,S_y realization makes their actual overlap irrelevant.
Five of the six pairs impose no constraint under any configuration.
The entire residual reduces to whether P_1^x and P_1^y share an internal vertex.
S_x and S_y add no simultaneous constraint to an A-C escape.
historical_residual_before_structural_su: Conditional on Q adding no further x-y path, the arithmetic audit would retain the full rooted color-preserving A,B,C,D incidence core with subdivision lengths. This is no longer a live residual because pole forcing eliminates its terminal row.
structural_supersession: Ancestor commit 7a3c1f7 already proves that an aligned pole of a cubic Type-T vertex cannot be cubic. Therefore X_x=y and X_y=x are impossible in T2; the pairwise results in this manifest are conditional abstract arithmetic, not a live Type-T residual.
